story_type: lava spattering from a fissure at night, real sound
hook: This is what lava fountaining out of the ground sounds like.
narration: This is the real sound of lava fountaining out of a crack in the ground in Hawaii.
Fissure 20 was one of the vents in Kilauea's Lower East Rift Zone in May 2018.
This video was taken on May 19, at about three forty-five in the morning.
Spatter is molten rock thrown up in blobs, and it piles up around the vent as it falls back.
outcome: Fissure 20 kept spattering and feeding its lava flow through the night.
title: The sound of lava fountaining at night
description:
Spattering and a lava flow at fissure 20 in the Lower East Rift Zone of Kilauea Volcano, Hawaii, around 3:45 a.m. on May 19, 2018, with the real sound of the lava fountaining.
